title: Advancing the Calibration-Compute Frontier of LLM Classifiers via Asymmetric Duos
abstract: arXiv:2611.19020v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The importance of reliable uncertainty estimation in large language models (LLMs) has become increasingly pronounced, yet modern models remain poorly calibrated and frequently overconfident. In this study, we address this by proposing an efficient method for LLM classifier calibration using the Asymmetric Duos framework. Our approach combines a strong base model with a smaller sidekick model via logit-space fusion, utilizing global scaling parameters optimized on a validation set. Across diverse benchmarks, this Asymmetric LLM Duo consistently achieves best or second-best performance on expected calibration error and negative log-likelihood, without degrading predictive accuracy. More importantly, these gains are realized at a fraction of the computational cost of more complex baselines, placing our method on the calibration-compute Pareto frontier. We further demonstrate that our method acts orthogonal to various established calibration

translated_title: 通过非对称双模型组合推进大语言模型分类器的校准-计算前沿
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）中可靠的不确定性估计的重要性日益凸显，然而现代模型的校准水平仍然欠佳，且经常表现出过度自信。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于非对称双模型框架的高效LLM分类器校准方法来解决这一问题。我们的方法通过logit空间融合，将一个强大的基础模型与一个较小的辅助模型相结合，并利用在验证集上优化的全局缩放参数。在多样化基准测试中，这种非对称LLM双模型组合在期望校准误差和负对数似然上始终取得最佳或次佳的性能，且不会降低预测准确性。更重要的是，这些收益仅需更复杂基线方法的一小部分计算成本即可实现，使我们的方法位于校准-计算的帕累托前沿。我们进一步证明，我们的方法与各种已有的校准方法相互正交（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出非对称双模型框架，通过logit空间融合将强大的基础LLM与小型辅助模型结合，以极低的计算成本显著改善LLM分类器的校准性能，同时不牺牲预测准确率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an Asymmetric Duos framework that fuses a strong base LLM with a smaller sidekick model via logit-space fusion, achieving state-of-the-art calibration performance at a fraction of the computational cost without sacrificing predictive accuracy.
